records.title: RLS kill-switch still honoured for the runtime role (rls_enforce / app_super_admin / bypass_rls / is_admin); only the pooled-connection carry-over is closed
records.evidenceAtHead: Unchanged policy shape: db/migrations/20260801_tenant_isolation_sweep.sql:184-198 (final sweep in C2C_MIGRATION_FILES) and migrations/0021_enable_rls_everywhere.sql:190-220 still lead USING/WITH CHECK with `NULLIF(current_setting('app.rls_enforce', TRUE), '') IS DISTINCT FROM 'on'` and end with `OR current_setting('app.current_user_role', TRUE) = 'app_super_admin'`. server/db/rlsEnforcement.ts has no commits in 92ccdba1..HEAD. identity.can_* still return TRUE on `app.bypass_rls='true'` (db/migrations/069_gcc_multitenant_rls_expansion.sql:95,128,167,222). No role default: grep for `ALTER ROLE ... SET app.rls_enforce` over *.sql/*.mjs/*.ts/*.tf returns nothing; scripts/db/provision-app-role.mjs sets none. Mitigation added after the audit: ac688076e (2026-10-08) server/db/sessionScope.ts:39-82 pins app.rls_enforce to the deployment mode and empties app.bypass_rls/app.is_admin whenever a scope is applied, and clears them on release; scripts/ci/check-session-scoped-rls-bypass.mjs:150-185 counts every server write of the three switches against an allowlist (wired .husky/pre-push:340, .github/workflows/ci.yml:571). sessionScope.ts:20-23 records that the policies 'are not a boundary against injected SQL'. Seven innovation services still issue session-level `SET app.bypass_rls='true'`/`SET app.is_admin='true'` (baseline at check-session-scoped-rls-bypass.mjs:57-65), e.g. server/services/innovation/submission-readiness-twin-service.ts:483-484, reachable from AnA tools (server/services/ana/AnaToolExecutor.ts) and cleared on release by server/services/innovation/rlsBypassSession.ts.
records.fixedBy: ac688076e: server/db/sessionScope.ts:39-82 (switch pins on apply, clear on release; used by establishRequestTenantScope, lazyRequestDbClient, withTenantConnection, poolInstrumentation) and scripts/ci/check-session-scoped-rls-bypass.mjs:150-185 (writer allowlist). Closes only the 'setting left on a pooled connection' vector.
records.remaining: Any app_service session that can run its own SQL (injection, psql/script, a second driver that omits the startup options) can still `SET app.rls_enforce='off'`, `SET app.current_user_role='app_super_admin'`, or `SET app.bypass_rls='true'` and read every tenant. There is no role-level default of app.rls_enforce=on, nothing in the database stops production enforcement from being switched off, and no DB test proves the switches are inert for app_service. The 'hard isolation at the database' claim to GxP buyers still does not hold; the code now says so explicitly.
records.severityRationale: The pilot has one customer tenant, and the primary isolation is at the app layer (global /api auth gate plus JWT-derived org scope). After D3 a switch set in one request cannot reach the next, and every server write of a switch is CI-gated. What remains is defence-in-depth against injected SQL or a new connection path. That is needed before enterprise GA, or before more than a handful of tenants share the cluster, but it does not stop a sales-led single-tenant pilot.
records.humanTestingNote: Not observable through the UI; testers see correct tenant scoping in normal use.
records.instructions:
1. Role default for paths that skip the startup packet. In scripts/db/provision-app-role.mjs (the grant recipe deploy-migrate runs), when RLS_ENFORCE resolves to 'on' (same rules as server/db/rlsEnforcement.ts readEnforcementMode), execute `ALTER ROLE <quote_ident(appRole)> IN DATABASE <current_database()> SET app.rls_enforce = 'on'`; when it resolves to off, `ALTER ROLE ... IN DATABASE ... RESET app.rls_enforce`. Extend the existing grant audit in that file to read pg_db_role_setting and fail deploy-migrate in production when the setting is absent.
2. Make production enforcement non-switchable by a session. Add `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.c2c_rls_floor() RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS 'SELECT <true|false>'`, owned by the owner role. deploy-migrate writes the body from RLS_ENFORCE (true in production). It must run before any policy that references it: add it at the top of the first set file, and to install-fresh before the overlay. app_service has CREATE on no schema, so it cannot replace the function. Change the leading clause of every tenant policy to `(NOT public.c2c_rls_floor() AND NULLIF(current_setting('app.rls_enforce', TRUE), '') IS DISTINCT FROM 'on')`. CLAUDE.md Rule 1 applies: amend the creators in place, each with a dated header note naming this change. Start with db/migrations/20260801_tenant_isolation_sweep.sql:184-198, db/migrations/20260801_uuid_tenant_isolation_nonpublic.sql, db/migrations/20260813_child_table_parent_scoped_rls.sql and migrations/0021_enable_rls_everywhere.sql:190-220, then every other file on an applier returned by `grep -rl "IS DISTINCT FROM 'on'" migrations db/migrations`. The sweeps DROP POLICY IF EXISTS and re-create on every deploy, so the change converges.
3. Do not let the runtime role grant itself cross-tenant reach (GA scope). Replace the `app.current_user_role='app_super_admin'` clause and the `app.bypass_rls`/`app.is_admin` short-circuits (069_gcc_multitenant_rls_expansion.sql:95-222) with `pg_has_role(current_user, 'c2c_platform', 'MEMBER')`. Create c2c_platform as a NOLOGIN role and grant it to a separate LOGIN role used only by the system-scope pool. That pool serves server/middleware/establishRequestTenantScope.ts:185, server/services/memory-consolidation-job.ts:110, server/services/audit/tenant-chain-verdict.ts:80 and server/services/audit/compliance-reports/integrity-checks.ts:38. app_service must not be a member.
4. Convert the seven session-level bypass writers in BASELINE (scripts/ci/check-session-scoped-rls-bypass.mjs:57-65) to SET LOCAL inside an explicit transaction, or remove them. They are outside the launch catalog (CLAUDE.md Rule 2), but submission-readiness-twin-service.ts is reachable from AnA tools, so removing it needs the replacement named by path (working agreement). Lower the baseline to lock each one in.
5. Add tests/db/rls-switches-inert.dbtest.ts. Seed two tenants' rows in one FORCE-RLS public table and in vault.documents. As app_service with tenant A scoped and the production floor, assert that each of SET app.rls_enforce='off', SET app.current_user_role='app_super_admin', SET app.bypass_rls='true' and SET app.is_admin='true' still returns only tenant A's rows. Also assert that a connection opened without startup options returns 0 rows with no scope. Run it against HEAD first and file the red output (2 of 2 rows), then make it green.
records.acceptance: 1) On a production-provisioned DB, `psql` as app_service with no PGOPTIONS shows current_setting('app.rls_enforce')='on', and an unscoped SELECT on a tenant table returns 0 rows (red at HEAD: all rows). 2) With tenant A scoped, each of the four switch SETs returns 1 of 2 rows on the generic table and 0 tenant-B rows on vault.documents (red at HEAD: 2 of 2 / 1 extra). 3) deploy-migrate exits non-zero in production when pg_db_role_setting lacks the default, shown by deleting it first. 4) The new dbtest runs in the ci.yml dbtest job, and its filed red/green output is attached. 5) The ci:session-scoped-rls-bypass BASELINE is empty, or each remaining entry is SET LOCAL in a transaction.
records.dependencies: DATA-03 (owner credentials in the runtime make DB-level isolation moot for any API compromise); DATA-02 (security-definer views bypass RLS regardless); ci:sql-interpolation stays blocking.

records.title: API and worker tasks still receive the RDS owner DATABASE_URL; boot DDL and /api/tenants still run as the owner
records.evidenceAtHead: terraform/stack/main.tf:95 composes database_url from module.rds.master_username. main.tf:315-317 puts DATABASE_URL (owner) and APP_DATABASE_URL into boot_secrets, which api_secrets (main.tf:431) and worker_secrets (main.tf:440) both use. main.tf:43-47 documents it as 'A known exposure'. .github/workflows/deploy-aws.yml:74-79 and 756-787 derive the migrate task from the API task definition, so the API task must carry DATABASE_URL; the preflight at deploy-aws.yml:514 requires DATABASE_URL in the API container. server/startup/env.ts:66-68 requires DATABASE_URL at boot. server/routes/tenants-simple.ts:67-75 still builds a postgres.js client on process.env.DATABASE_URL, mounted at /api/tenants (server/bootstrap/register-tenant-routes.ts:51). Its 12 queries run as the owner with no tenant GUCs, outside RLS. Commits since the audit (78d316062, 2ab30c93e, 06152498b, 1596454a9) changed authorization and purge only, not the connection. Boot DDL as the owner: server/startup/services.ts:129-131 calls ensureCoreTables(process.env.DATABASE_URL), whose auto-create runs CREATE TABLE (server/db/ensureCoreTables.ts:458-583) with no production guard. server/db/bootstrap/index.ts:30-44 opens an owner pool for ensureAuthTables (schema migrations, org and demo seeds, module catalog DDL). The boot posture probe (server/db/rlsEnforcement.ts:186-300) checks only the runtime pool's role.
records.remaining: All of it. DATABASE_URL must be removed from the API and worker tasks, with a separate migrate task definition. Boot DDL and seeds must move into deploy-migrate. tenants-simple must move onto the app pool under a system or platform scope. A boot assertion must refuse an owner URL in production.
records.severityRationale: Requests are served by app_service (NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS) and the posture probe holds, so tenant isolation works in normal operation and the pilot can start. Any API compromise (RCE, env or log leak), however, yields the RDS master. With it an attacker can run DDL, read every non-FORCE table, and DISABLE the Part 11 append-only triggers. /api/tenants already runs outside RLS. This must be closed before pilot users rely on production records.
records.humanTestingNote: Not observable in testing. /api/tenants and boot behave normally; this is credential and infrastructure posture.
records.instructions:
1. Write the failing check first. In terraform tests/boot_contract.tftest.hcl, add assertions that the api and worker container definitions contain no secret or env named DATABASE_URL. Run `terraform test` against the current terraform/stack/main.tf and file the red output.
2. terraform/stack/main.tf: split boot_secrets (lines 315-330) into runtime_secrets (no DATABASE_URL, no APP_SERVICE_DB_PASSWORD) and migrate_secrets (runtime_secrets plus DATABASE_URL and APP_SERVICE_DB_PASSWORD). Set api_secrets (line 431) to runtime_secrets plus SETUP_TOKEN, and worker_secrets (line 440) to runtime_secrets. Add a Terraform-managed migrate task definition (family c2c-production-migrate) with the same image variable, execution role, log config and migrate_secrets. Update the main.tf:35-60 comment.
3. .github/workflows/deploy-aws.yml: in the migrate step (around lines 756-800), derive the one-off task from the migrate family instead of the API revision. Alternatively, extend scripts/ops/ecs-one-off-task.sh to accept an extra secrets list and inject the database_url secret ARN. Remove DATABASE_URL from the API preflight list (line 514), and add a preflight that fails when the API container definition contains DATABASE_URL. Apply the same change to provision-database.yml.
4. server/startup/env.ts:66-68: when NODE_ENV=production, require APP_DATABASE_URL and refuse boot if DATABASE_URL is set. Keep the dev fallback.
5. server/startup/services.ts:129-131: in production call ensureCoreTables() with no connection string, so it uses the runtime pool in verify-only mode. In server/db/ensureCoreTables.ts:458-590, skip autoCreateTables when NODE_ENV=production and report a missing table as a readiness failure. If `documents` still needs creating, put it in a C2C_MIGRATION_FILES file (IF NOT EXISTS, before the final sweep pair, per Rule 1).
6. server/db/bootstrap/index.ts:22-71: in production, open no owner pool. Move applyAuthSchemaMigrations, applyModuleCatalogSchema and seedOrganizations into deploy-migrate, as a set migration or a new deploy-migrate step that runs as the owner. Leave a read-only verification at boot. Do not seed the GA demo user in production.
7. server/routes/tenants-simple.ts:66-75: delete the postgres.js client and cleanDatabaseUrl. Use `pool` from '../db' (already imported at line 14). Run the platform-admin cross-tenant list and the purge, deletion and cancel paths under runWithSystemTenantScope, and member reads under the request scope. Confirm the organizations policy admits both.
8. Boot assertion: in server/db/rlsEnforcement.ts assessRlsCatalogPosture, add a failure when current_user owns any relation in a non-system schema. Add another when process.env.DATABASE_URL is set under NODE_ENV=production.
9. Have the founder or ops run `terraform apply` and a deploy. Then confirm the running API task definition has no DATABASE_URL.
records.acceptance: 1) The tftest asserting no DATABASE_URL in the api/worker containers was red on the old main.tf and is green after. 2) The CI production boot smoke boots with APP_DATABASE_URL only and /readyz=200. Setting DATABASE_URL in production refuses boot, shown failing first. 3) An integration test of GET /api/tenants shows a platform admin gets every org, a member gets only their orgs, and `SELECT current_user` on the serving connection is app_service. 4) Booting against a DB where app_service has no CREATE logs no DDL and no 'Could not auto-create'. 5) The deploy-aws.yml preflight fails on an API task definition that contains DATABASE_URL. 6) After apply, `aws ecs describe-task-definition` for the API and worker shows no DATABASE_URL.
records.dependencies: An AWS terraform apply and deploy by the founder or ops. Moving boot DDL into deploy-migrate overlaps DATA-05 and DATA-07 (migration set discipline).

records.title: Authoring signatures and authoring audit trail are now append-only in the database; section-version history is still rewritable, and the new triggers are not checked at boot
records.evidenceAtHead: Fixed after the audit. Commit 00f94ee9f (2026-10-01): migrations/20261001_domain_history_append_only.sql:166-181 adds BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE (row) and BEFORE TRUNCATE (statement) triggers on public.authoring_signatures, and on workflow_history, document_audit_logs, regulatory_audit_logs and c2c_ana_actions. The file is in the set at scripts/db/migration-set.mjs:2883. scripts/db/provision-app-role.mjs:199-250 lists authoring_signatures (line 244) and authoring_audit_trail (line 212) in APPEND_ONLY_TABLES, and withholdAppendOnlyPrivileges (lines 486-515) REVOKEs UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE from app_service on every deploy. Commit 7863cf830 (2026-09-29, after the audit) amended db/migrations/20260725_authoring_audit_trail.sql:69-110 with append-only and no-truncate triggers (AUTHORING_SUBSYSTEM_FILES). QMS controlled-document approvals write electronic_signatures (server/services/qms/document-approval-signature.ts:349), which is trigger-protected. I ran: clone of the audit-state DB c2c_cold_eval (92ccdba1) into a scratch DB. As app_service in tenant 9001, the audit's `UPDATE authoring_signatures SET signer_name='Someone Else', meaning='reviewed', signed_at=now()-'30 days'` gave UPDATE 1 and the DELETE gave DELETE 1 (red). After applying HEAD's 20261001 file and the HEAD revoke, both gave 'permission denied for table authoring_signatures'. As owner, the trigger raised 'IMMUTABILITY_VIOLATION: authoring_signatures is append-only ... UPDATE refused', and TRUNCATE was refused too (green). Scratch DB dropped. Still open, on the same DB: has_table_privilege(app_service, c2c_document_section_versions, UPDATE/DELETE) = t/t with 0 user triggers. At HEAD no file on any applier creates a trigger on c2c_document_section_versions (the only `ON` match is an index), and the table is not in APPEND_ONLY_TABLES. It is the section's 'Part-11 history' read by server/routes/c2c/documents.ts:411-431 and server/services/governance/separation-of-duties.ts:152, and it cascades from c2c_document_sections (migrations/20260528_phase9_document_schema.sql:127). server/services/audit/audit-immutability-triggers.ts:44-93, the boot, securityHealth and sweep check, does not list trg_authoring_signatures_* or the other 20261001 triggers. No CI gate enumerates signature, audit or history tables that lack a trigger. submission_leaves has no DB guard for frozen or dispatched sequences (service-level only). authoring_audit_events has no writer in server/ (dead).
records.fixedBy: 00f94ee9f migrations/20261001_domain_history_append_only.sql:166-181 (authoring_signatures triggers); scripts/db/provision-app-role.mjs:212,244 and 486-515 (UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE withheld from app_service, DP-66); 7863cf830 db/migrations/20260725_authoring_audit_trail.sql:69-110 (authoring_audit_trail triggers)
records.remaining: c2c_document_section_versions, the per-change section snapshot used as the Part 11 history on the AnA document/canvas Authoring path, is still UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE-able by app_service and has no trigger. trg_authoring_signatures_* and the other domain-history triggers are not in EXPECTED_AUDIT_IMMUTABILITY_TRIGGERS, so a disabled trigger would not fail boot or the sweep. There is no CI gate that catches the next unprotected signature, audit or history table. Frozen or dispatched submission_leaves are protected only in application code.
records.severityRationale: The demonstrated P0 is closed at HEAD: Authoring e-signature rows can no longer be rewritten or deleted by the app role. The residual section-history gap is still a 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e) audit-trail weakness on a launch-catalog journey (Authoring). It must be closed before pilot users rely on those records, but it does not stop the pilot starting.
records.humanTestingNote: Not observable in the UI. Signing, section edits and section history behave normally; the gap is database-level mutability.
records.instructions:
1. Write the failing test first. Extend tests/db/domain-history-append-only.dbtest.ts with a case that, as app_service in its own tenant, runs UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE on c2c_document_section_versions and expects each to be refused (42501 or IMMUTABILITY_VIOLATION). Run it at HEAD and file the red output.
2. Census before adding the trigger. grep confirms no server or script path UPDATEs or DELETEs c2c_document_section_versions, c2c_document_sections or c2c_documents. Check server/services/tenant/tenant-offboarding.ts PURGE_CHILD_TABLES (line 907) and the GDPR erasure path. If either must erase the history through the ON DELETE CASCADE from c2c_document_sections, add an owner-run door function as 06152498b did for turn records.
3. Add migrations/20261014_section_version_history_append_only.sql to C2C_MIGRATION_FILES right after 'migrations/20261001_domain_history_append_only.sql' (scripts/db/migration-set.mjs:2883) and before the final sweep pair. It reuses public.domain_history_append_only(), is guarded by to_regclass('public.c2c_document_section_versions'), and does DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS of its own names, then creates trg_c2c_document_section_versions_append_only (BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE, FOR EACH ROW) and trg_c2c_document_section_versions_no_truncate (BEFORE TRUNCATE, FOR EACH STATEMENT). Give the file a header with the census. It creates no table and drops nothing another file creates (Rule 1).
4. Add { schema: 'public', name: 'c2c_document_section_versions' } to APPEND_ONLY_TABLES in scripts/db/provision-app-role.mjs (after line 250).
5. Add to EXPECTED_AUDIT_IMMUTABILITY_TRIGGERS in server/services/audit/audit-immutability-triggers.ts:44-93: the two new triggers, trg_authoring_signatures_append_only and trg_authoring_signatures_no_truncate, and the eight workflow_history, document_audit_logs, regulatory_audit_logs and c2c_ana_actions triggers from 20261001. The source for each is its migration path. Update the pglite test server/services/audit/__tests__/audit-immutability-triggers.pglite.test.ts.
6. Add a gate, scripts/ci/check-record-table-immutability.mjs plus a selftest, wired into package.json, .husky/pre-push and .github/workflows/ci.yml. For every table created by a file on an applier whose name matches /(signature|signatures|audit|audit_trail|_history|_versions)$/, require an APPEND_ONLY_TABLES entry and an EXPECTED_AUDIT_IMMUTABILITY_TRIGGERS entry, or a baseline entry in scripts/ci/record-table-immutability-baseline.json with a written reason. Show it failing on c2c_document_section_versions before step 3.
7. Optional (P2): in a new set file, add a BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger on submission_leaves that refuses when the parent sequence is frozen or dispatched. Read the status column from migrations/20260604_submission_core_canonical.sql. This mirrors the service-level refusal in server/services/submission-service/submission-service.ts.
records.acceptance: 1) The dbtest case was red at HEAD (UPDATE 1 / DELETE 1 on c2c_document_section_versions) and is green after the change: UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE are refused for app_service, and UPDATE and DELETE are refused for the owner by the trigger. 2) A section edit through the c2c documents route still appends a version row (existing tests green). 3) Booting against a DB with trg_authoring_signatures_append_only disabled reports it missing or disabled in assertAuditImmutabilityTriggers, shown by ALTER TABLE ... DISABLE TRIGGER first. 4) The new CI gate fails on a fixture table named *_signatures without a trigger, and passes at the end. 5) deploy-migrate's grant audit shows UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE withheld on c2c_document_section_versions.
records.dependencies: None blocking. Related to DATA-16 (remaining signature and audit stores) and DATA-10 (signature/audit store consolidation).

records.title: Upgrade path still not proven to converge with a fresh install: new off-deploy-path migrations are now refused, but there is no upgrade fingerprint gate and the known divergent tables are not converged
records.evidenceAtHead: Added after the audit: scripts/ci/check-migration-deploy-path.mjs (38a5c1b4e, 2026-10-01) refuses a NEW top-level migrations/*.sql that is not in C2C_MIGRATION_FILES, AUTHORING_SUBSYSTEM_FILES or the drizzle journal. It is wired at .husky/pre-push:201 and .github/workflows/ci.yml:93. Its baseline, scripts/ci/migration-deploy-path-baseline.json, holds 113 off-path files, including 0012_project_charter_timeline.sql (line 22) and 20260629_protocol_deviations.sql (line 104). The gate does not detect edits to baselined files. I ran a node import of both appliers: 113 of 324 migrations/*.sql are on no deploy applier, and none of them changed in 92ccdba1..HEAD. Still open: (a) no CI job provisions an earlier release and then runs HEAD deploy-migrate. A grep of .github/workflows and scripts/ci for upgrade, previous-tag and fingerprint logic finds nothing; ci:replay-rebuilds-nothing replays the same version. (b) No file on any applier converges the retired drizzle-shaped tables. db/migrations/20260323_assumption_decision_contradiction.sql:50,113 creates assumption_records and decision_records with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, and its own header (line 23) says IF NOT EXISTS 'converges nothing'. The same holds for db/migrations/20260725_governance_boundary_tables.sql:26,78 (governance_boundary_rules and _transitions), and nothing converts cmc_comparability_assessments.tenant_id text to integer. None of these files changed since the audit. The HEAD writers still use the canonical columns (server/services/assumption-registry-service.ts:411-414 assumption_code, title; server/services/decision-record-service.ts:207-210 decision_code) and are mounted via server/bootstrap/register-governance-routes.ts:30,37. (c) scripts/ci/check-migration-reachability.mjs:22-33 still counts the install-fresh overlay and drizzle push as durable (unchanged since the audit), and scripts/db/deploy-migrate.mjs runs no push. (d) Journal drift is still discarded (DATA-07).
records.fixedBy: 38a5c1b4e scripts/ci/check-migration-deploy-path.mjs (a new migrations/*.sql must be on a deploy applier; wired .husky/pre-push:201, ci.yml:93)
records.remaining: Still missing: an upgrade-convergence CI job (provision the previous release, run HEAD deploy-migrate, diff the fingerprint against fresh HEAD), and a convergence migration for assumption_records, decision_records, governance_boundary_rules/_transitions and cmc_comparability_assessments.tenant_id. Edits to the 113 baselined overlay-only files and drizzle-push-only shapes still never reach an existing database while the deploy reports 'safe to roll services'. Journal drift is not acted on (DATA-07). Whether any staging or production RDS already predates HEAD is unknown from the repo.
records.severityRationale: A pilot production DB provisioned fresh from HEAD starts correct. The first release after go-live, though, can leave production on a schema that differs from what the code expects, with 500s or failed writes, while the deploy reports green and nothing detects it. That is a data-integrity and availability risk that must be closed before pilot users rely on production. The new deploy-path gate removes the most common cause but not the class.
records.humanTestingNote: Not hit on a database freshly provisioned from HEAD. If a staging DB was provisioned from an older commit and only upgraded, testers can see 500s or 'column ... does not exist' on the assumption, decision and governance-boundary records and on other upgraded surfaces. Workaround: provision the test DB fresh from HEAD (npm run db:provision) rather than upgrading an old one.
records.instructions:
1. Add scripts/db/schema-fingerprint.mjs, read-only, that prints sorted lines for: columns (schema.table.column, type, NOT NULL, default); constraints (pg_get_constraintdef, whitespace-normalised); indexes (pg_get_indexdef); policies (qual, with_check); relrowsecurity/relforcerowsecurity; triggers (name, tgenabled, function); and md5 of function and view definitions. Exclude pg_catalog, information_schema and extension objects.
2. Add an `upgrade-convergence` job to .github/workflows/ci.yml, using the same postgres16+pgvector service as the dbtest job at ci.yml:1501-1560. (a) Resolve BASE from a new file deploy/production-baseline.sha. deploy-aws.yml writes it after a successful production migrate; until then use the newest v* tag. (b) Run `git archive $BASE | tar -x -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/base"`, a read-only export with no branch or worktree (Rule 0). Run `npm ci` there and its `node scripts/db/provision.mjs` into db c2c_upgrade. (c) Run HEAD's `node scripts/db/deploy-migrate.mjs` against c2c_upgrade. (d) Run HEAD's `npm run db:provision` into c2c_fresh. (e) Diff the two fingerprints. Fail unless the diff is empty or every line is in scripts/ci/upgrade-convergence-baseline.json with a non-empty reason. Prove it red first with BASE=54927bde: it must list the assumption_records, decision_records, governance_boundary_* and cmc_comparability_assessments.tenant_id lines. File that output under docs/evidence/.
3. Add migrations/20261014_retired_shape_convergence.sql to C2C_MIGRATION_FILES, after the creators and before the final sweep pair; ci:migration-set-order must pass. For each of assumption_records, decision_records, governance_boundary_rules and governance_boundary_transitions, detect the retired shape (for example, assumption_records.category with udt_name 'assumption_category', or decision_records lacking decision_code).
